description: Frontend real session + admin UI: replace the mock AuthContext with a real session from GET /auth/me, enforce role-aware routing, rebuild Login as real email/code+password with forgot-password, add set/reset-password-from-link and change-password pages, and add an Admin area (users, create lecturer, Excel student import with per-row errors, subjects, assign lecturers). Depends on FEAT-001 (/auth endpoints + cookies) and FEAT-002 (/admin endpoints). Must be done last.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/e2e-step2-auth/context.json and this file FIRST; read FEAT-001.json and FEAT-002.json findings for the exact /auth and /admin request/response shapes. Do not re-explore what context.json already states.

Replace frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx with a real provider: on mount fetch GET /auth/me (credentials:'include'); expose {user,loading,login(identifier,password),logout(),refresh()} where login POSTs /auth/login then re-fetches /auth/me and logout POSTs /auth/logout. Store the server user including uppercase role. Fix frontend/src/config/api.js to use import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL with the http://localhost:3000 fallback. Add frontend/src/services/authApi.js wrapping fetch with credentials:'include'.

Update frontend/src/App.jsx: ProtectedRoute reads user+loading, redirects to / when unauthenticated, shows a loading state while /auth/me resolves, and compares against a required uppercase role; add an /admin route group guarded for ADMIN and map /lecturer->LECTURER, /student->STUDENT.

Rebuild frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx as a real email-or-code + password form with a forgot-password link; add frontend/src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx, frontend/src/pages/SetPassword.jsx (consumes ?token= for SET and RESET), and frontend/src/pages/ChangePassword.jsx (logged-in, calls PUT /auth/password). Keep UI copy in the current language (English).

Update frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx and frontend/src/components/Topbar.jsx to use the real user (role/name) and the real logout(); add Admin nav entries when role is ADMIN. Reuse frontend/src/components/ui/* (Button, Input, Card, Table, Badge, Modal, Feedback).

Add frontend/src/pages/admin/Users.jsx (list users, create-lecturer modal, lock/unlock, resend setup link, import-students file upload rendering the per-row error table from the backend) and frontend/src/pages/admin/Subjects.jsx (subject CRUD + assign-lecturers), wired into the /admin routes.

Run cd <WT>\frontend; npm install; npm run build and npm run lint and fix until both exit 0. Commit locally on branch feat/e2e-step2-auth. Record any remaining manual/runtime checks in this file's findings.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT>\frontend; npm run lint (oxlint) exits 0 with no new errors.
The mock role-picker login and the fake AuthContext are removed; AuthContext resolves the session from GET /auth/me.
Routes are guarded by server role (ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT) and an /admin area exists with users+subjects management and Excel student import.
verification: cd <WT>\frontend && npm install && npm run build
findings:
Implemented and verified. cd frontend; npm install then npm run build exits 0 (vite build, 2322 modules) and npm run lint (oxlint) exits 0. The only lint output is pre-existing WARNINGS (never errors): the react(only-export-components) notice on AuthContext.jsx (useAuth hook + AuthProvider in one file, same shape as the original mock), react(set-state-in-effect) on the admin pages' data-fetch useEffect (standard load-on-mount), and unused-import warnings in the untouched lecturer/student pages. oxlint exit code is 0, satisfying the acceptance criterion.

== What changed ==
- frontend/src/config/api.js: now reads import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL with the http://localhost:3000 fallback (removed the invalid process.env usage).
- frontend/src/services/authApi.js (NEW): apiRequest() fetch wrapper with credentials:'include'; always JSON-decodes, surfaces backend {message,code} on the thrown error as err.status/err.code/err.details; handles 204. Exports getMe, postLogin(identifier,password), postLogout, postRefresh, postForgotPassword, postResetPassword, postSetPassword, putChangePassword.
- frontend/src/services/adminApi.js (NEW): listUsers(role?), createLecturer, updateUser, lockUser, unlockUser, resendSetup, importStudents(file) (sends raw .xlsx bytes with the spreadsheet Content-Type), listSubjects, createSubject, updateSubject, deleteSubject, assignLecturers.
- frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx: real provider; fetches GET /auth/me on mount; exposes {user,loading,login,logout,refresh}. login POSTs /auth/login then re-fetches /auth/me; logout POSTs /auth/logout. Stores the server user incl. uppercase role. Removed the fake role/name login.
- frontend/src/App.jsx: ProtectedRoute reads {user,loading}, shows a loading spinner while /auth/me resolves, redirects unauthenticated to '/', and compares user.role against the required UPPERCASE role (ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT), redirecting mismatches to their role home. Added /forgot-password, /set-password (SET), /reset-password (RESET), per-area /*/change-password routes, and the ADMIN-guarded /admin group (users, subjects).
- frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx: real email-or-code + password form + forgot-password link; navigates to the role home on success; 423 => locked message, others => invalid-credentials message. Removed the mock role-picker.
- frontend/src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx (NEW): enumeration-safe; always shows the same confirmation.
- frontend/src/pages/SetPassword.jsx (NEW): shared by SET and RESET via the mode prop; reads ?token=, validates >=8 chars + confirmation, calls set-password or reset-password, redirects to '/'.
- frontend/src/pages/ChangePassword.jsx (NEW): logged-in form calling PUT /auth/password.
- frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx + Topbar.jsx: use the real user (role/fullName) and async logout(); Sidebar shows ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT nav by uppercase role incl. Admin Users/Subjects.
- frontend/src/pages/admin/Users.jsx (NEW): user list, create-lecturer modal, lock/unlock, resend setup link, and Excel import that renders the backend's per-row {row,errors[]} table on a 422.
- frontend/src/pages/admin/Subjects.jsx (NEW): subject CRUD + assign-lecturers modal (replace-set) populated from listUsers('LECTURER').
- All reuse components/ui/* (Button, Input, Card, Table, Badge, Feedback, Loading) and components/Modal; UI copy is English.

== Remaining runtime checks (require the live backend; not verifiable offline) ==
1. GET /auth/me round-trip and cookie-based session persistence across reload need a running backend with DB_MOCK_MODE=false and valid auth cookies.
2. CSRF: browser fetch with credentials:'include' sends the Origin header automatically; confirm VITE_API_BASE_URL matches an allowed origin (env.appBaseUrl) so non-GET calls are not rejected 403.
3. Excel import: the per-row error table rendering was validated against the documented 422 { ok:false, errors:[{row,errors[]}] } shape but not against a real .xlsx upload.
4. SET/RESET email links: the pages consume ?token=; confirm the backend email link path (/set-password?token= and /reset-password?token=) matches these routes.
